experiment: IoT-23 real Zeek traffic through the live AegisWeave pipeline
warning: IoT-23 is a set of 2018-2019 lab captures of a few IoT devices and malware samples on one research network. These measurements do not establish performance on other networks. Temporal-block tests share hosts and capture periods with training; leave-capture-out is the stronger generalization evidence.

dataset.name: IoT-23
dataset.citation: S. Garcia, A. Parmisano and M. J. Erquiaga, IoT-23: A labeled dataset with malicious and benign IoT network traffic, Stratosphere Laboratory, 2020

checks: withheld classes absent from all fitting partitions
duplicate flow vectors reported; test also scored on unseen vectors

context_isolation.method: rebuild eligible records with fresh state per contiguous partition run
context_isolation.limitation: Temporal blocks still share capture environments and hosts, and are interleaved rather than forward-only. State resets introduce cold starts. Context isolation does not prove cross-network generalization or eliminate repeated flow vectors.

definitions.flagged: any decision other than normal (includes unknown abstention)
definitions.wrong_attack_attribution: analyst-facing label is a known attack class that differs from the true label
